name: captain-midi
description: Local Expo module exposing iPadOS CoreMIDI to CaptainPad. Implements the frozen MidiTransport surface (listEndpoints / openSource / openDestination / send / midiMessage / endpointsChanged) directly against CoreMIDI, so the mapping/dispatch/LED stack in utils/midi/ runs unchanged over USB-C on the FoH iPad.
author: Titanic's End
